svg.title: IIT Mandi finance portal - complete architectural flow and detailed atlas
svg.desc: Nine source-verified diagrams covering the entire after-midsem website, commit a96512e.
svg.text: IIT MANDI / INTEGRATED FINANCE MANAGEMENT PORTAL
Complete architectural flow | after-midsem | source commit a96512e | 12 October 2026
Implemented branch architecture. Demo login retained. Deployment and live database state not assumed.
01 Complete website flow
Identity -> role landing -> purchase workflow -> money, records and follow-up

g.title: login
g.text: LDAP bind OR retained fixed demo accounts
Database employee must exist and be active
Role is read from employees, not the form

g.title: user
g.text: Own bills, progress and PDA balance

g.title: manager
g.text: Open, allocate, top up, close accounts

g.title: submit
g.text: Reserve free funds once; log submission

g.title: rejected
g.text: Refile as a new bill if needed

g.title: views
g.text: QR + print: no public data access

g.title: mail
g.text: Failure does not undo the decision

svg.text: Store & Purchase is displayed as SNP in the reference; its stored role/status is Student Purchase.
02 Runtime and trust boundaries
Self-hosted Docker: public HTTPS edge, private application and private database

g.title: proxy
g.text: 10 MB body limit; 60 s read timeout

g.title: next
g.text: Dynamic root and Node route handlers

g.title: server
g.text: db: shared pg Pool, default max 10

g.title: ldap
g.text: OU bind over configured LDAP URL

g.title: backup
g.text: Protect + copy off host; test restores

svg.text: This is the configured runtime, not evidence that the current commit has been deployed.
03 Authentication, session and role access
Authentication proves identity; employees defines permissions on every
authenticated request

g.title: democheck
g.text: Wrong demo password: reject, no fallback

g.title: employee
g.text: Read role, department, name and email
Database failures do not grant a fallback

g.title: jwt
g.text: Refresh live employee on session access

g.title: navigate
g.text: Allow only safe local callback paths

g.title: u
g.text: API: submit / held edit / note own bill

g.title: b
g.text: File, held edit, note for own department

g.title: e
g.text: Held edit + rejected note API, scoped

g.title: s
g.text: Only decide bills at Store & Purchase
Read all bills; guarantee details on approve

g.title: a
g.text: Only decide bills currently at Audit

g.title: f
g.text: Decide only at Finance Admin; PDA read

g.title: p
g.text: Open / allocate / top up / close PDA
No bill filing or approval privilege

svg.text: Demo login remains intentionally available. Production needs explicit enablement and a
non-empty password.
04 Bill form and submission transaction
The full form survives end-to-end; the server computes money and PostgreSQL
reserves it once

g.title: w4
g.text: Qty, UOM, unit price, issued qty

g.title: w6
g.text: Validate all six steps before sending

g.title: draft
g.text: Not a server record / not a money reserve

g.title: derive
g.text: Recognised item types, UOM and funds
Money finite, cents, total < Rs 10 billion
Sum rounded qty x unit price + charges

g.title: retry
g.text: Existing key: compare stored MD5 hash

g.title: funds
g.text: Applicant still active; sufficient free money

g.title: insert
g.text: Insert bill: filer, form, invoice, revision=1

svg.text: A bill has 1-100 structured item lines, retained in bills.form_data; flat columns are
compatibility/display fields.
05 Approval, hold, correction and rejection
Database-authoritative state machine with revision checks and separation of duties

g.title: guards
g.text: Live active reviewer; owns current desk
Active PDA locked for safe settlement

g.title: hold
g.text: Desk stays the same; no money movement
May be reviewed again without amendment

g.title: amend
g.text: Current hold required; active PDA locked

g.title: reset
g.text: Preserve bill number / stock / retry identity

g.title: reject
g.text: No register entry; no amendment allowed

g.title: refile
g.text: New bill identity and retry UUID
Rejected invoice can be filed again

svg.text: Threshold is strictly greater than Rs 50,000. Exactly Rs 50,000 skips Audit.
06 PDA money lifecycle and directory administration
The conservation invariant is enforced in PostgreSQL, not by browser arithmetic

g.title: cluster_wallet
g.text: PDA MONEY STATES - AMOUNT A / CORRECTION DELTA D

g.title: spent
g.text: Free does not change at acceptance

g.title: read
g.text: q / department filters; read-only for Finance

g.title: write
g.text: PATCH: set allocated OR positive top_up
DELETE: close, never delete the row

g.title: pdalock
g.text: No lost updates or close/submit race
Money finite and at most two decimals

g.title: directory
g.text: Dean + Finance Admin may read directory
Finance Admin creates plain User only
Initial allocation on create: Dean only
Employee + optional PDA in one statement

g.title: tx
g.text: On failure: ROLLBACK on same connection

svg.text: allocated = balance + committed + spent; every component is non-negative and finite,
stored as numeric(12,2).
07 Database model, constraints and audit records
Eight public tables; structured item detail lives in JSONB, not a separate items
table

g.title: department
g.text: Active lookup list + register serial prefix

g.title: register
g.text: PK id UUID; UNIQUE bill_id FK

g.title: json
g.text: lines[]: key, group, type, brand, model

g.title: constraints
g.text: Invoice index excludes Rejected / null legacy
Revision++ on bill UPDATE; applicant fixed
Stock ID assigned once and preserved
New constraints NOT VALID preserve legacy

svg.text: Solid relationships labelled FK are enforced foreign keys; dashed relationships are
logical/snapshot links only.
08 API surface, read flows, QR and notification
All financial reads/writes are mediated by Next.js route handlers; no browser-to-
database access

g.title: browser
g.text: Failure on any page discards partial list

g.title: me
g.text: Any actor: own identity, home, active PDA

g.title: lookup
g.text: User: self only; staff: any active employee

g.title: bills
g.text: User forced to own; non-User global read

g.title: detail
g.text: User owns bill; staff may read all

g.title: register
g.text: User forced own purchases; staff global read
All authorised FY choices + current IST FY

g.title: page
g.text: Browser print; escaped BillCard print HTML

g.title: qr
g.text: QR link to current bill URL
Not a payment QR or public token
Scan -> same bill URL -> session check
Sign-in callback returns to this record

g.title: mailcheck
g.text: Read bill and applicant's current email

g.title: smtp
g.text: Send errors logged, never rolled back

svg.text: /api/departments has no session guard; it returns only active public department metadata.
09 Setup, deployment, verification and limits
Safe upgrade path preserves existing balances, bills, approvals and register
history

g.title: code
g.text: Lint + type errors block production build

g.title: empty
g.text: npm run db:setup refuses any public table

g.title: initial
g.text: Live: insert first Dean's LDAP employee ID
Dean provisions users and workflow roles

g.title: demoseed
g.text: Adds missing fixed demo accounts only
New accounts get Rs 250,000 starter PDA
Not automatic on setup or Docker startup

g.title: backup
g.text: Default retain last 30; copy off host

g.title: upgrade
g.text: Ambiguous IDs halt for administrator review

g.title: checks
g.text: npm run db:test: isolated temp cluster

g.title: limits
g.text: No PO / supplier / building master service
Fund choices currently OH-31 and OH-35
No attachments / blob or object storage
No payment gateway or bank settlement API
No email outbox, durable queue or retries
No database RLS; app guards read scope
No public QR access / public register writes
Shared-password demo is a retained risk

svg.text: The diagram documents commit a96512e on after-midsem, including migration 0004; live
schema/deployment was not inspected.
Solid arrows: request, control or enforced relationship. Dashed arrows: configuration, follow-up or logical relationship.
Blue UI | Amber identity/holds | Purple API/workflow | Green database/money | Red rejection/error | Cyan external
